reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for orchestrating human-supervised delivery workflows with planning, implementation, structured review, quality gates, persistence, and progress visualization.

summaries.zh: 用于 DeepSeek Harness 的双智能体交付协作插件，编排方案规划、代码修复、只读审查、人工验收及交付报告生成流程。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that coordinates planning, code fixing, read-only review, human acceptance, and delivery report generation in a structured multi-agent workflow.

capabilities: Coordinates fixer, reviewer, and planner subagents in a state-machine-driven delivery workflow
Supports a read/write fixer subagent and read-only reviewer and planner subagents
Generates and persists review materials, round records, and delivery reports
Hooks write, edit, pwsh, and bash tool activity to refresh review materials
Provides structured user prompts and a web-based activity status panel
